# Lab 19.2: Search & Discover Data

## What We Are Going to Do
Find data across projects with keyword search, filters and natural-language search.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Keyword search.** In the BigQuery Explorer or Knowledge Catalog search, type `orders`. Results include tables, views and models from all projects you can see.

2. **[Console] Filter.** Narrow by **Type: Table**, **Project: bq-course-lab**, **Location: US**. Add a filter on a label such as `course: bigquery` (Lab 2.1).

3. **[Console] Natural-language search.** Switch on semantic search and type: *"tables with customer orders and their status"*. The results include tables that never use the word "status" in their name.

4. **[CLI] Search with the API.**

5. **[Console] Use search qualifiers.** Try `name:orders type=TABLE` and `column:email` to find every table with an `email` column.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Keyword search | By names, descriptions, columns |
| Filters | Type, project, location, labels |
| Natural language | Finds by meaning |
| API | `searchEntries` |
